originality.rationale: Source-level comparisons: the 2015 k-independent work counts extremal sets, the 2020 higher-independence paper bounds induced component sizes instead of induced degrees, and the 2020 higher-matching paper selects edges rather than vertices. Indexed nearest results likewise concern different simplicial objects. Full natural integral symmetry and zero adjacent persistence maps are not entailed by these sources; unindexed equivalent treatments remain a residual risk.
residual_risks: An equivalent statement might exist under a less familiar name in unindexed graph topology literature.

The nonequivariant sphere-wedge splitting is elementary once the exact face decomposition is recognized, but novelty is claimed for the combined complete integral representation and adjacent-map persistence classification, not for any single standard skeleton identity.
